item.title: Tokyo Marathon — Guide
item.description: The Tokyo Marathon, held annually in late winter or early spring (typically around March), is Japan’s biggest marathon and one of the six prestigious Abbott World Marathon Majors, alongside events like Boston, London and New York. Tens of thousands of runners take part in the 42.195 km race, which follows a spectacular course through the heart of Tokyo, passing many of the city’s greatest landmarks — starting near the Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building in Shinjuku and running past sights such as Iidabashi, Asakusa’s Kaminarimon and Senso-ji, Ginza, Tokyo Station and finishing in the Marunouchi area.
